text: Which statement about resting membrane potentials is correct according to the unit on the intelligent cell?
choices: Only neurons and muscle cells maintain a resting membrane potential
A resting membrane potential requires gap junctions between cells
All living cells maintain a resting membrane potential across their membrane
Membrane potentials exist only during action potentials
explanation: The unit stresses that membrane potentials are a universal feature of living cells, not a neural specialty, arising from ion gradients set by pumps and selective channel permeability. Option 0 is the neuron-centric misconception the chapter refutes. Gap junctions (option 1) couple cells electrically but are not required for a single cell to have a potential. Option 3 confuses the resting potential with the transient action potential.
